इष्टका: इष्टका íṣṭa-kā, f. brick: -gṛha, n. brickhouse.
इष्टकामदुह्: इष्टकामदुह् iṣṭa-kāma-duh, f. (nm. -dhuk) cow of plenty (milking =) granting all desire.
इष्टजन: इष्टजन iṣṭa-jana, m. beloved person, lover;  -devatā, f. favourite or tutelary deity.
इष्टर्ग: इष्टर्ग iṣṭárga, m. one who fights in front or beside (as a protector).
इष्टलाभ: इष्टलाभ iṣṭa-lābha, m. acquisition of a desired  object.
इष्टव्रत: इष्टव्रत iṣṭá-vrata, a. fulfilling wishes; -saṃpādin, a. procuring what is desired; -sādhana, a. id..
इष्टापूर्त: इष्टापूर्त iṣṭā-pūrtá, n. sg. & du. wish (or sacrifice)  and fulfilment = reward of pious works; C. sacrifice and pious works.
इष्टि: इष्टि iṣ-ṭí, f. incitement, furtherance; helper.
इष्टि iṣ-ṭí, f. seeking, search;  wish, desire.
इह: इह i-há, ad. here, hither;  here on earth; in this book;  in the following;  now, in a moment;  often = lc. of idam.
इहत्य: इहत्य ihá-tya, a. belonging to this place.
इहलोक: इहलोक iha-loka, m. this, i.e. the present world.
इहस्थ: इहस्थ iha-stha, a. being or remaining here.
इहामुत्रफलभोगविराग: इहामुत्रफलभोगविरागiha‡amutra-phala--bhoga-virāga, m. indifference to the pleasures of reward in this world and the next.
